myStory.title: My Story
content: With over 15 years of experience in full-stack development, I specialize in helping tech businesses systematize processes and build scalable projects. My journey has been defined by a passion for creating solutions that work and empowering teams to make smart technology decisions.

As a Google Developer Expert for Flutter and Dart, and a platform engineer at Appwrite, I bring hands-on expertise in building systems that are not only technically sound but also maintainable and scalable. My approach is rooted in practical experience, having built and optimized systems for real-world applications.

I aim to help non-tech businesses identify bottlenecks that can be automated through technology integration, enabling them to scale effectively. Whether it's choosing the right architecture, setting up development processes, or fostering a culture of innovation, I guide teams toward solutions that drive measurable improvements.

Beyond consulting, I am committed to knowledge sharing and community building. Through educational content and open-source contributions, I have reached 100K+ developers globally, showcasing my dedication to advancing the technology ecosystem while delivering value to clients.
